name: phosphor-glyphs
description: A theme from the turntable display's glyph visualizer: phosphor colors that show where the session runs, and a glyph backdrop that moves with what it is doing.

thisComputer.title: This computer's color
thisComputer.description: The phosphor color for sessions running on this computer. Cloud sessions are always cobalt and SSH sessions mint, so pick another for each of your own computers.
